
'''Ankoku-no-Miyatsuko''' (安国造) was a {{ill|Kuni no miyatsuko|en|Kuni no miyatsuko|qid=Q2483673|lt=Kuni no Miyatsuko}}, or regional ruler, who governed the eastern part of {{ill|Ōmi Province|en|Ōmi Province|qid=Q843882|lt=Ōmi Province}} along the eastern shore of {{ill|Lake Biwa|en|Lake Biwa|qid=Q200239|lt=Lake Biwa}}. The title is also referred to as "Ōmi Ankoku-no-Miyatsuko" (淡海安国造) or "Kinan Ankoku-no-Miyatsuko" (近淡海安国造).

== Overview ==
=== Ancestry ===
According to the {{ill|Kojiki|en|Kojiki|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki}}, Ankoku-no-Miyatsuko's ancestor was {{ill|Mizuho no Mawaka no Mikoto|ja|水之穂真若王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunohowake no Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135578859}}, a son of {{ill|Hikoimasu no Ōkimi|lt=Hikoimasu no Ōkimi|lt=Hikoimasu no Mikoto|ja|日子坐王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikoimasu no Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 彦坐王}}, and is thus considered related to the {{ill|Q11559784|ja|淡海国造|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmi-no-Kuni no Miyatsuko|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11559784}}.

=== Clan ===
The Ankoku-no-Miyatsuko belonged to the '''{{ill|Q28684171|ja|安氏|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yasu clan|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q28684171}}''' (Yasu-uji), whose {{ill|Kabane|en|Kabane|qid=Q1664099|lt=Kabane}} was '''{{ill|Ason|ja|直 (姓)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ason|qq=}}'''.

=== Base of Operations ===
The Ankoku-no-Miyatsuko governed from {{ill|Yasu District, Shiga|en|Yasu District, Shiga|qid=Q8049933|lt=Yasu District}} in Ōmi Province, corresponding to modern {{ill|Yasu, Shiga|en|Yasu, Shiga|qid=Q611642|lt=Yasu}} and {{ill|Moriyama, Shiga|en|Moriyama, Shiga|qid=Q857225|lt=Moriyama}} in {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|en|Shiga Prefecture|qid=Q131358|lt=Shiga Prefecture}}. Some sources suggest they later came under the control of the {{ill|Q11559784|ja|淡海国造|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmi-no-Kuni no Miyatsuko|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11559784}} [citation needed].

=== Clan Deity ===
The clan's {{ill|Ujigami|en|Ujigami|qid=Q767655|lt=Ujigami}} is unknown, but {{ill|Ame-no-Mikage-no-Kami|ja|天之御影神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Mikage-no-Kami|qq=}} has been suggested.<ref>Kenji Kawaguchi, *Tokyo Bijutsu Selection 23: Continuation of the Genealogies of the Gods* (Tokyo Bijutsu, 1980), p. 66.</ref>

=== Notable Figures ===
* '''Ōtamusaka no Mikoto''' (大多牟坂王, also known as Ōtamuya Wake or Ōtamuwake)
** The first Ankoku-no-Miyatsuko of Ōmi. He was a third-generation descendant of {{ill|Hikoimasu no Ōkimi|lt=Hikoimasu no Ōkimi|lt=Hikoimasu no Mikoto|ja|彦坐王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hikoimasu no Mikoto|qq=}} or a descendant of {{ill|Amatsuhikone|ja|天津彦根命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Amatsuhikone|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to アマツヒコネ}}.
* '''Futaji Hime''' (布多遅比売, also known as Ryōdōiri Hime)
** Daughter of Ōtamusaka no Mikoto. She married {{ill|Yamato Takeru|ja|倭建命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamato Takeru|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ヤマトタケル|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q461258}} and bore {{ill|Inaiwawake no Mikoto|ja|稲依別王|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Inaiwawake no Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.
* '''Sakata Tarine no Kimi''' (坂田垂根君)
** Son of Ōtamusaka no Mikoto.
